text_en: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
text_cn: 恶人无人追踪，仍然窜逃；义人安然自得，有如雄狮。

text_en: When a land rebels it has many rulers; but with an intelligent ruler there is lasting order.
text_cn: 由于国家的罪，领袖时有更迭；惟赖明哲之士，邦国方能久存。

text_en: A ruler who oppresses the poor is a beating rain that leaves no food.
text_cn: 欺压弱小的恶霸，有如冲没谷粮的暴雨。

text_en: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law struggle against them.
text_cn: 违法的人，称扬败类；守法的人，与之为敌。

text_en: The evil do not understand justice, but those who seek the Lord understand it completely.
text_cn: 作恶的人，不明了正义；寻求上主的，却全洞识。

text_en: Better to be poor and walk in integrity than to be crooked in one’s ways even though rich.
text_cn: 为人正直的穷人，胜于行为邪僻的富人。

text_en: Those who keep the law are wise children, but companions of gluttons shame their parents.
text_cn: 遵守法律的，是智慧之子；交结荡子的，是取辱己父。

text_en: One who augments wealth by exorbitant interest gathers it for another who is kind to the poor.
text_cn: 谁放贷取利增加己产，是为怜恤贫乏者积蓄。

text_en: When one will not listen to the law, even one’s prayers are an abomination.
text_cn: 对于法律，人若充耳不闻，他的祈祷，也为上主所恶。

text_en: Those who mislead the upright into evil ways will fall into pits of their own making, but the blameless will have a goodly inheritance.
text_cn: 勾引正直的人走上邪路的，必落在自己所掘的坑内；但正直的人仍能继承幸福。

text_en: The rich is wise in self-esteem, but an intelligent poor person sees through the pose.
text_cn: 富贵的人，自认为有智慧，聪明的穷人一眼即看穿。

text_en: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory, but when the wicked prevail, people go into hiding.
text_cn: 义人获胜，群情欢腾；恶霸当道，人人走避。

text_en: No one who conceals transgressions will prosper, but one who confesses and forsakes them will obtain mercy.
text_cn: 文过饰非的，必不会顺利；认错悔改的，将蒙受怜悯。

text_en: Happy is the one who is never without fear, but one who is hard-hearted will fall into calamity.
text_cn: 常戒慎的人，必蒙祝福；心硬如铁者，必遭灾祸。

text_en: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a poor people.
text_cn: 暴君欺凌贫穷弱小，有如咆哮怒狮，饥饿野熊。

text_en: A ruler who lacks understanding is a cruel oppressor; but one who hates unjust gain will enjoy a long life.
text_cn: 无知的昏君，必横行霸道；憎恨贪婪的，将延年益寿。

text_en: If someone is burdened with the blood of another, let that killer be a fugitive until death; let no one offer assistance.
text_cn: 身负血债者，虽逃至死地，也无人搭救。

text_en: One who walks in integrity will be safe, but whoever follows crooked ways will fall into the Pit.
text_cn: 行走正路的，必安然无恙；爱走曲径的，必堕入陷阱。

text_en: Anyone who tills the land will have plenty of bread, but one who follows worthless pursuits will have plenty of poverty.
text_cn: 自耕其地的，必常得饱食；追求虚幻的，必饱尝贫苦。

text_en: The faithful will abound with blessings, but one who is in a hurry to be rich will not go unpunished.
text_cn: 忠诚笃实的人，将满渥福祉；急于致富的人，将难免无过。

text_en: To show partiality is not good— yet for a piece of bread a person may do wrong.
text_cn: 顾及人的情面，原非一件好事；但为一片面包，人却陷身不义。

text_en: The miser is in a hurry to get rich and does not know that loss is sure to come.
text_cn: 眼睛贪婪的人，匆匆急于致富；岂知贫乏穷困，即将临他身上！

text_en: Whoever rebukes a person will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
text_cn: 责斥他人的，终比奉承的，更得人爱戴。

text_en: Anyone who robs father or mother and says, “That is no crime, ” is partner to a thug.
text_cn: 向自己父母行窃，却说“这并不是罪，”与强盗是同路人。

text_en: The greedy person stirs up strife, but whoever trusts in the Lord will be enriched.
text_cn: 贪得无厌的人，必引起争端；信赖上主的人，必心安理得。

text_en: Those who trust in their own wits are fools; but those who walk in wisdom come through safely.
text_cn: 自恃聪明的，实是糊涂人；行事智慧的，必安全无恙。

text_en: Whoever gives to the poor will lack nothing, but one who turns a blind eye will get many a curse.
text_cn: 乐施济贫的，决不会匮乏；视若无睹的，必饱受咒骂。

text_en: When the wicked prevail, people go into hiding; but when they perish, the righteous increase.
text_cn: 恶霸当道，人人走避；恶霸灭亡，义人兴旺。
